subject: Insurance
title: How Insurers Invest Your Premiums
description: Learn How Insurers Invest Your Premiums in one minute.

hook.text: Life insurers collect premiums for decades before paying claims. In between, they invest the money—mostly in bonds.

buildup.text: US life insurers hold over $4 trillion in invested assets. They're among the largest institutional investors on Earth.

discovery.text: Bonds match perfectly: steady income that arrives on schedule, just like the predicted death claims insurers must pay.

twist.text: When interest rates dropped to near zero in 2020, insurers' investment income shrank.

climax.text: Life insurance is really two businesses: selling risk protection and investing money. Profit comes from both.

punchline.text: $4 trillion invested. Insurers make money from your premiums before you die.

quiz.question: Where do life insurers primarily invest premiums?
